# PR Summary

Journey-Step: #<issue-number>
Closing-Issues:
- Closes #<issue-number>
Executor: <Codex CLI | Claude Code | OpenCode | Human | Other>

## What / Why

- What problem this PR solves and why this approach is appropriate.

## Plan

- What will change and why.

## Outcome

- What changed.

## Files / Modules touched

- Major files, modules, packages, or configuration touched and why.

## Acceptance criteria

- Map each issue acceptance criterion to the concrete outcome.

## Validation

- Formatting, lint, static analysis, and tests run with results.
- CI status or explicit reason CI is not applicable.

## Risk

- Risk level.
- Mitigations or rollback notes.

## Open questions / follow-ups

- Deferred work that should become a follow-up issue rather than expanding this PR.

## Agent Self-Review

- Spec adherence: acceptance criteria satisfied, partials, and deviations.
- Tool feedback summary: tests, lint/format, CI, and known failures.
- Confidence and known risks: areas reviewers should spot-check.
